version: Buildpack API 0.12 / Platform API 0.15 / Distribution API 0.3
description: On-disk and on-image structure of a v3 Cloud Native Buildpacks build. Describes the canonical artifacts a buildpack, builder, lifecycle, and produced OCI image carry, drawn directly from buildpacks/spec.

buildpack_root.bin/detect: Required executable invoked during the detect phase. Reads $CNB_PLATFORM_DIR and writes $CNB_BUILD_PLAN_PATH.
buildpack_root.bin/build: Required executable invoked during the build phase. Reads $CNB_BP_PLAN_PATH, writes layers under $CNB_LAYERS_DIR plus launch.toml/build.toml/store.toml.

layers_dir.$CNB_LAYERS_DIR/launch.toml: Processes, labels, slices emitted by the buildpack.
layers_dir.$CNB_LAYERS_DIR/build.toml: Unmet requirements emitted by the buildpack.
layers_dir.$CNB_LAYERS_DIR/store.toml: Persisted buildpack metadata carried across rebuilds.
layers_dir.$CNB_LAYERS_DIR/<layer>.sbom.{cdx,spdx,s: Per-layer SBOM in CycloneDX, SPDX, or Syft format.

platform_dir.$CNB_PLATFORM_DIR/env/: User-provided environment variables (one file per var).
platform_dir.$CNB_PLATFORM_DIR/bindings/: Optional service bindings exposed to detect and build.

lifecycle_artifacts.run.toml: Run image references and mirrors (Platform API 0.12+).
lifecycle_artifacts.builder.toml: Builder configuration consumed by `pack builder create`.
lifecycle_artifacts.project-metadata.toml: Source and version info propagated to io.buildpacks.project.metadata.

oci_labels.io.buildpacks.build.metadata: Buildpacks executed, processes declared, launcher info.
oci_labels.io.buildpacks.lifecycle.metadata: Layer digests, run image, exec env.
oci_labels.io.buildpacks.project.metadata: Source repo, version, project descriptor metadata.
oci_labels.io.buildpacks.base.distro.name: Run image distribution name.
oci_labels.io.buildpacks.rebasable: true when the run image base is ABI-compatible with replacement bases.

build_time.CNB_BP_PLAN_PATH: Resolved buildpack plan read at build.
